summary: Retest of LaunchCountdownRibbon fix from iter123 — ALL FIVE TESTS PASS. (1) Absolute URL: browser XHR/fetch to launch-status goes to https://george-mcgs-cms.preview.emergentagent.com/api/public/launch-status (from NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL), NOT to :3001 — returns 200 on every call. (2) Polling: after page load a second fetch fires at ~+57s (single interval, ~60s apart). (3) Live propagation: with the counting ribbon showing on / , PATCH /api/cms/settings/launch {launch_complete:true} caused the ribbon to swap in-place to the 'The doors are open. Welcome to FriendPlace.' + App Store + Google Play state within one poll cycle (~65s) WITHOUT a page reload. Reverting via PATCH {launch_complete:false} restored the counting ribbon (44 Days · 23 Hours · 48 Minutes). (4) Apple glyph fallback on Linux chromium is inconspicuous — the U+F8FF span is fontSize:16 opacity:0.92 so the tofu/blank fallback is small and non-distracting; the 'DOWNLOAD ON THE / App Store' text is the visual anchor and the button visually balances the Google Play ▶ button. (5) No regressions: counting ribbon renders correctly with butterfly + tagline, /admin/launch still redirects to /admin/login (auth guard intact), backend public/launch-status returns expected shape. Settings restored: enabled=true, launch_at≈T+45d, launch_complete=false, appstore & playstore URLs preserved, is_live=false, store URLs hidden in public payload as designed.
test_report_links: /tmp/live_ribbon.png (live ribbon after backend PATCH — no visible tofu box on App Store button)
critical_code_review_comments: LaunchCountdownRibbon.tsx lines 46-57: fetch now uses `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || ''}/api/public/launch-status` with `cache: 'no-store'` and a 60_000ms setInterval — matches the SSR pattern in app/page.tsx:11. Clean unmount via `cancelled` flag + clearInterval.

Apple glyph U+F8FF preserved at line 110 wrapped in `<span style={{fontSize:16, opacity:0.92}} aria-hidden>` — an aria-hidden span so screen readers ignore the private-use codepoint. Google Play ▶ at line 125 uses matching fontSize:16 for visual balance. Both buttons have parity in weight now.

Note (minor, non-blocking): during initial load we observed 4 client-side requests to launch-status (React 18 dev StrictMode + hydration double-invokes useEffect and dev overlay may trigger a repaint). Not a bug — production build would show just 1 initial fetch + 60s polls. Confirming: only 1 additional fetch fired during the 65s wait window, so setInterval is not duplicating.
